primary_goal: 按用户定向任务和Storage Modeling Workplan，统一SSD/NVMe/HBF/NAND底层NAND模型，核查channel/package/die/plane/block/page、page read/program/erase、跨页拆分、plane/die并行、顺序program、队列与后台工作是否到达真实访问/计费链路。
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

baseline.role: H39 DRAM family发布源码；H40 NAND候选源码e1f5425；H26/H30旧NAND结论不继承

previous_direction: 存储硬件建模粒度-DRAM家族（H39）
direction_switch_reason: H39已完成DRAM家族有限参数化入口，按Workplan顺序切换到SSD/HBF共同NAND模型；不复制两个介质模型，也不重开DRAM延期项。
recent_directions: H38:计算成本模型有限负向扫描
H39:存储硬件建模粒度-DRAM家族
H40:存储硬件建模粒度-NAND家族（活动）

scope.candidate: 共享NAND family profile与真实page/plane/die/program/erase/queue访问入口；SSD/HBF差异只在profile/controller边界
include: logical/physical bytes、page/program/erase count、等待与触发原因
exclude: 无来源字段不填精确默认值

problem_domain_closure.background_work: explicit marker preserved, no invented FTL/GC cost
problem_domain_closure.deferred: die/channel scheduling dimensions and full FTL/GC

data_roles.development: fresh NAND/HBF/SSD source and execution-chain scan; ONFI/OCP/vendor facts only where accessible
data_roles.holdout: 整页、跨页、跨plane、读写混合、队列饱和、program/erase和后台控制

guardrails: SSD/HBF/NAND共用底层NAND模型，不复制两个介质逻辑
不得用端到端时延反推page/plane/die/queue参数
不得把metadata增加称为真实建模
不加载Native，不把单测通过称为精度改善
next_step: 轮换到运行速度/内存或评估/API；没有新来源/瓶颈证据时不继续制造NAND细粒度轮次。
